summary:
The headline today isn't a hot streak — it's a data freeze. Every rating shows 0-0 at the 14-day window, confirming we're deep enough into the calendar that games have thinned out, so trust has to shift to the 30-day and season windows instead of chasing recent noise. The one live signal worth carrying into tonight's card is the SP category's 3-game winning streak across all four ratings (R1-R4 all showing "sp: streak 3W"), paired with bullpen_fatigue's matching 5-game losing streak across the board. That's not a coincidence — it's the model telling you starting pitching reads are outperforming bullpen fatigue reads right now, so on any game tonight where SP and bullpen_fatigue disagree, side with the rotation arrow. Combine that with the category-pair data: trends+sp is the best-performing combo at 58% (370-268, n=638), so if tonight's board has a game where trends and SP both agree, that's your top-confidence play of the slate.

On team trust, lean into LAD and BOS if either shows up tonight — LAD strong plays are running 80% (28-7, +27.0u) and BOS strong plays sit at 76% (22-7, +19.0u), both well clear of the field. MIL (69%, n=74) and TBR (70%, n=63) are the volume leaders and still profitable on strong plays (+18.0u and +21.0u respectively), so they're bankable if they appear as favorites tonight. Fade NYY hard if the model likes them as a strong play — 9-14 (39%, -4.0u) is the only team leader bleeding units, and it's happening on volume (n=47), not small sample noise. Across ratings, R3 and R4 remain the sharpest tools in the box: R3's season strong-play line is 266-196 (58%, +92.0u) and R4 is hitting 64% (119-68, +63.0u) on far fewer picks — if R3, R4, and the trends+sp combo all stack on the same team tonight, especially LAD or BOS, that's the shape of the night's best bet.
